concat_dataframes_vertical: concat multiple DataFrames vertically into a single DataFrame with matching columns
concat_dataframes_diagonal: concat DataFrames with different columns diagonally, filling missing values with null
concat_dataframes_horizontal: concat DataFrames horizontally side-by-side, stacking columns from multiple frames
union_dataframes: union multiple DataFrames vertically without guaranteeing row ordering for performance
align_frames_by_column: align multiple DataFrames by common key column values, injecting null rows for missing keys
